mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 47 degrees at Verona Community Park under clear skies with a waxing gibbous moon. The air quality index is at a moderate 77, and we are expecting an overnight low of 43 with no rain. Also, catch the ISS crossing the sky tomorrow at 5:45 AM as it travels from Mount Horeb toward the Madison area near Home Depot for three minutes.

The City of Verona has several updates for residents. The Mark Drive reconstruction project is continuing through its second phase, with concrete work and gravel installation currently underway. Additionally, residents can now participate in a toilet rebate program or sign up for the Eye On Water service to track utility usage via the city website.

There is plenty to do in Verona this week. Tomorrow offers Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, Thursday brings the start of Art House 360 nights and Hop Haus Trivia, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee later in the week.

In a noteworthy report from October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. The driver was apprehended near the intersection of Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace, and fortunately, no injuries were reported.

The Culver's of Verona location is now closed for the evening. You can look forward to tomorrow's flavor of the day, which will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry, when the restaurant reopens at 10:00 AM.
